grammar.summary: 本课学习 must have done 表对过去的推测（复习）。

points.title: must have done 推测过去
points.explanation: He must have known that the police would never allow this sort of thing. 对过去发生之事的肯定推测：must + have + 过去分词。

examples.en: It must have been an amusing sight.
examples.cn: 那肯定是个有趣的场面。

points.title: ought to have done 表本应
points.explanation: You ought to have known better. 本该更明智（实际没有），含责备。ought to have done = should have done。

examples.en: He ought to have gone along a side street.
